'''Haarm Sornell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who served the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3962 BBY]], he spent his time in the war alongside his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Koblus Sornell]] and their son [[Gheedor Sornell]].
